name: share-chart
title: Share Chart
description: How a whole splits into parts, one bar per row: survey answers by group, a budget by department, time by activity. Each row is one 100% bar cut into segments, and every row shares one scale, so rows compare at a glance.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/share-chart

Installed to `components/ui/charts/share-chart.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/charts/share-chart';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/share-chart

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
